BiblicalUsage: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD, for He shall pluck my feet out of the net. Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me, for without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the net is laid in secret, and only the God who sees in secret can pull a man's feet out of it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
